versions.changelog:
- API Compliance: Adjusted parameter passing for pro_matches, public_matches, and teams to align strictly with OpenDota OpenAPI definitions. Safely handled object/array schema parsing discrepancies for team endpoints.
- Separation of Concerns: Extracted hardcoded game constants (ranks, game modes, lobby types, attributes) from translations.json into a dedicated dota_constants.json file.
- Performance: Implemented local caching for English hero names (hero_en_names.json) to eliminate redundant network requests and improve command latency.
- UX Improvement: Added automatic conversion of 64-bit Steam IDs to 32-bit Account IDs in the CLI entry point.
- Localization: Replaced hardcoded UTC+8 time formatting with local system timezone calculations.
- Resiliency: Centralized HTTP request logic and introduced an auto-retry mechanism for HTTP 429 Rate Limit responses.
- Documentation: Updated SKILL.md and README files to reflect the new caching file and automated Steam ID support.
- Improve skill documentation for agent usage

Version 1.0.4 of dota2-stats-skill

- Unified filter parsing in cmd_wl and cmd_matches to use parse_filters()
- Added significant=0 to wl, matches, heroes, peers, totals, counts commands
- Ensures all match data is returned including non-standard modes

- Fix .gitignore encoding from UTF-16LE to UTF-8 so git can parse ignore rules
- Increase search command timeout from 15s to 120s for slow database queries
- Add progress tips with wait message before search API call
- Suggest using account_id directly for faster lookup
- Update timeout_error message to remove hardcoded "15 seconds"
- Change the skill name and update the MD file.
